meta.delta_preregistration: Delta is unspecified by the plan. Pre-registered set {1,3,5}: Delta=1 is the plan's degenerate end and equals E5-fin's recurrence label; 3 and 5 keep censoring under ~12% on the labelled cohort. All three are reported; the censoring table extends to 10 and 20 so the trade-off is visible.
meta.label: label_D = 1[ t1 - t0 >= D ], t0/t1 the first/last observed step; eligible only if t0 <= 49 - D
meta.multi_task_note: one output head per Delta per arm, sharing one trunk and a single training run; all arms treated identically

censoring_note: `excluded_censored` = addresses with t0 > 49 - D, for which the label cannot be satisfied inside the window. They are EXCLUDED from that Delta's eligible set, never relabelled 0.

t0_structural_zero.note: an address first seen at t0 can satisfy t1 - t0 >= D only if t0 <= 49 - D. At t0 = 49 the D = 1 label is a structural zero, not a low rate; at D = 5 it is a structural zero for all t0 >= 45. Any statement that persistence 'falls with Delta' partly restates this window effect.

delta1_equals_recurrence.note: label_D at D = 1 is 1[t1 > t0], i.e. 1[n_steps_observed >= 2]

edges.distinct_out_definition: cumulative SUM of per-step distinct counterparty counts

feature_matrix.source: rebuilt from the timed edge stream truncated at t0; no column of wallets_features is used as a feature

graph.note: dedup affects message passing only; degree features keep edge multiplicity

naive_leaking_baseline.features: all 55 non-key, non-time columns of the provided wallets_features.csv (address-level lifetime aggregates)
naive_leaking_baseline.admissibility: INADMISSIBLE. Not a baseline -- a measurement of the leak. Every one of these columns is computed over the address's whole lifetime, i.e. over steps after t0, so the model is handed the answer. At Delta = 1 the label is literally 1[num_timesteps_appeared_in >= 2] and that column is in this matrix.
naive_leaking_baseline.note: The plan names an 'MLP 特征基线'. Built the plan's way -- from the provided table -- it is this. The plan's own risk table fires a fallback ('降级为 GraphSAGE + 手工时序特征') when the temporal GNN improves little over the baseline; against this baseline every honest arm would look weak, so the fallback would fire on an artefact of the baseline rather than on a property of the GNN. That is why `mlp_feature_only` above is rebuilt from the edge stream truncated at t0 instead.

mlp_feature_only.features: own activity at step <= t0 only (no graph structure)

1.class12_subset_note: predictions of the SAME model restricted to the labelled cohort; no separate model was trained on it (E5-fin-comparable)

3.class12_subset_note: predictions of the SAME model restricted to the labelled cohort; no separate model was trained on it (E5-fin-comparable)

mlp_feature_only.score_convention: test metrics use the eligible test set te_m & OK[:, k] for each Delta

graphsage.features: own features + graph structure (edges <= t0) + a 2-layer SAGEConv embedding on the cumulative snapshot graph
graphsage.graph: undirected deduplicated timed address->address edges, cumulative snapshot per step; all 822,942 addresses are nodes

1.class12_subset_note: predictions of the SAME model restricted to the labelled cohort; no separate model was trained on it (E5-fin-comparable)

tgn.graph: same snapshot graph as the GraphSAGE arm; TGN events are the same deduplicated (src, dst, step) stream

leak_control.feature: t1 - t0, the label's own source (label_D = 1[t1-t0 >= D])
leak_control.purpose: must reach AUC ~ 1.0. If it does not, the pipeline cannot see the answer even when handed it, and the arms' results are uninterpretable.

shuffled_label_control.purpose: train labels permuted; test AUC must sit at ~0.5

feature_filter_verification.note: recomputed from the raw AddrTx/TxAddr/txs_features CSVs. `leq` counts edges with step <= t0 and must equal what the pipeline stored; `gt` counts edges with step > t0 and must DIFFER, otherwise the filter is inert and the equality above would prove nothing.

columns_used_from_file: Time step (to define t0/t1 and the label only)

positive_control.note: `Time step` is deliberately NOT excluded from the positive control. The first version of this check excluded it by name, which made `n_varying == 0` true by construction: the instrument had never been shown able to return a nonzero value, so its empty result proved nothing.

label_identity.note: at Delta = 1 the label is 1[n_steps_observed >= 2], so this column is the label in disguise. No arm uses it.
